# Hand-in results (generated by `make_handin.py`)

130 solution files, all feasible under the official referee (`qoblib_tools.py`). 128 of the instances have a QOBLIB best-known value (BKV): **19 beat it, 108 match it, 1 is above it** (largest gap 0.045%). Negative gaps beat the BKV. Binary variables = the official QUBO size, `(6n + 4 cash-slack + 7 count-slack bits) x T`.
